question.text: Let <math><mn>2</mn><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>b</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>, <math><msub><mrow><mi>l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi>l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> are straight lines of the family <math><mi>a</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> which are at <math><mn>1</mn></math> unit distance from the point <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced></math>, then the area (in sq. units) bounded by <math><msub><mrow><mi>l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><msub><mrow><mi>l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> and coordinate axes is

solution.text:
All the lines of the family of ax+by+c=0 pass from the point 2,2.
The line passing through 2,2 and at unit distance from 1,1 is x=2 and y=2
⇒ Required Area =2×2=4 sq. units
